items.question: How does {name} work?
items.answer: You enter the company you're interviewing with, select the interview rounds you're preparing for, and we research publicly available information to predict the questions you might face. Each prediction comes with evidence and prep notes.

items.question: Is this legal? Do you scrape LinkedIn?
items.answer: We only use publicly available web search results. We never scrape LinkedIn or access private profiles. Interviewer names are used only as a search seed to find their public work like talks or blog posts.

items.question: How accurate are the predictions?
items.answer: Every question comes with a confidence score and evidence links. When evidence is strong, confidence is high. When we're working with limited data, we say so honestly.

items.question: What companies work best?
items.answer: Tech companies with active engineering blogs, published interview processes, or candidates who share their experiences online tend to have the richest data.

items.question: Can I use this for any interview type?
items.answer: Yes. We cover DSA, system design, behavioral, domain quizzes, take-home projects, pair programming, and HR/culture rounds.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: No plans, no subscription — just credits. Every feature is included in every pack. A report costs what it costs to research: typically about 46 credits, and never more than {maxCredits}.
